notes.title: Gamescom 2025: DarkSwitch Preview — Steam Punk Survival in the Trees
notes.notes:
DarkSwitch was the first appointment I booked at gamescom 2025, thanks to a friendly PR rep who saw my attendance announcement on X—shout-out to Alex! Luckily, he knew his audience, and I was exactly the right person to come check out the game, perhaps even to a fault. I have been very invested in city builders late, with Thrive: Heavy Lies The Crown, Citadelum and even Civ VII on my gaming playlist (Yes, I know, Civ is more strategy, but they all belong under the same umbrella to me). I am so glad I booked the appointment, as Cyber Temple is building something I really can’t wait to get my hands on with DarkSwitch.

Throughout the game, your world will need to learn to survive in the trees and battle a dangerous fog and its mysteries to the best of their ability. The story goes deeper than this, into an ancient power or technology, but for the purpose of this demo, we aren’t there yet. For now, you construct buildings to the side and wrap around trees to avoid this deadly fog.... Read more

notes.title: Development Diary #2
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/2c07d60b7eba2896886934fce33035b87e8169cd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Shine bright, Arelians! [/h2][p] [/p][p]As we get closer to the release of the new demo on August 18th, we wanted to highlight a few of the game’s key mechanics with some new screenshots. Each of these systems plays a vital part in the successful management of your city, and each is linked to the others in a web of competing priorities and complimentary benefits. Choose wisely, Archon![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Vertical City[/b] [/p][p]The majestic trunks of the gigantic Ardentis Trees offer sanctuary from the Shroud, sheltering and sustaining the Aurelian people hundreds of feet above the forest floor. Although vital to survival, this does present some significant challenges for civil engineering. Settlement founders will need to consider space and placement, ensuring adequate ladders and ziplines to each building, as well as leaving space for any expansions you might want to build in the future. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/48b4a838a24691490e48772f37ef456f12388c80.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Shroud[/b] [/p][p]This shifting, malevolent shroud is a blight on the landscape of Nelaai. To be lost in the Shroud is to lose your mind, your sanity shredded by powers unknown; or to have your flesh torn and mangled by the stalking horrors which lurk within it. The Shroud covers the surface of the world, flowing more thickly and aggressively at night. Flame and light have always kept it at bay, but reports are surfacing of flameguards being overrun, we may need something stronger... [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/d3c78aeb8bf5b68abc8483024b55231165446696.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tower Defence[/b] [/p][p]The power at the heart of the Ardentis Trees can be harnessed to power a devastating defensive arsenal. Utilise the solar energy stored within its sap to power these fearsome weapons systems, forming networks which combine technology with the mystical. These remarkable structures will require extensive research and large amounts of materials, but they will prove indispensable in the fight against the Shroud. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/4433c0d294ae05351db6aee704171e0831e5d923.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gathering Resources[/b] [/p][p]The heart of all of our endeavours is the will of the worker, their rough hands our most important machinery. Without their labour in the fields, gathering metal and harvesting lumber, we would not eat, research or build. Even the lowliest citizen of Elaran plays their part – assigning them to the right tasks will be key to your success, so make sure you’re actively managing shift patterns and worker welfare. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/788d483d2aed7f913ed6bb7e55b879c8f2758834.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’re looking forward to the demo’s release as much as we are! Remember, this is just a taste of what you can expect to see in the demo on the 18th, so make sure you tag that wishlist button while you’re here. [/p][p][/p][p]~DarkSwitch Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/e6bbc5a8a4aa9e39ad96899e3092a6f63ae67779.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Build a city, save the world...
notes.notes:
[p]
 The Tree provides, The Tree protects, The Tree prevails! 

[i]The world of Nelaai is trapped in a cycle of destruction. The bones of forgotten civilisations litter its surface, lost beneath the deadly blanket of The Veil: a terrible fog which harbours madness and monster alike. The Arelian people live far above it, safe in the boughs of the mighty Ardentis trees, which house their settlements, but The Veil is rising...[/i]

Welcome to [b]DarkSwitch, a vertical city-builder with survival elements[/b] and an emotive story filled with meaningful moral choices. In DarkSwitch, you’ll lead an expedition investigating the collapse of a research outpost on the fringes of the empire. Faced with limited resources and an increasingly aggressive environment, re-establishing the settlement is your priority. 

Build on and around the trunk of a gigantic Ardentis tree, safely away from the creeping Veil beneath. But the tree can’t provide everything you need; resources must be gathered from the forest floor. Construct a network of defensive structures and bonfires to keep the Veil at bay whilst your workers toil, but be wary of the monsters who call the Veil home, they are becoming bolder by the night...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/42e77ec9d95a937bb43e822ea45c4a132a16d5a4.png"][/img]
Begin an unforgettable adventure requiring strategy, planning, logistics, and bravery as you seek out the forgotten knowledge of a lost civilisation. Harness the power of the trees themselves to defend against the denizens of the Veil. 

DarkSwitch is the debut title from CyberTemple, a new indie studio based in Almaty, Kazakhstan. We’re a proudly independent team of 40 people, and we’re all incredibly proud to be able to announce our first game. 

This is a huge moment for us, and we want to thank you for taking the time to look at DarkSwitch. Please add the game to your wishlist if you’re interested, and join us on [url="https://discord.gg/SaF7VUZfNN"]Discord[/url] to learn more about the game and offer your feedback. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/82a7cd10c56c74d2cea203439569c58668ac901d.png"][/img]

 12+ hours of single-player campaign featuring a richly woven storyline.
 80+ unique buildings and structures for a fully customizable colony.
 10 distinct resources, 5 raw and 5 processed.
 4 technology levels to unlock and advance your civilization.
 3 storylines based upon 3 main protagonists adventures
 A 1,000 x 1,000 meter local map paired with a 2,000 kilometer global map for exploration and expansion.
 A towering 200-meter tree as the foundation of your vertical city.
 40 minutes of atmospheric music by Akira Yamaoka.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/e6bbc5a8a4aa9e39ad96899e3092a6f63ae67779.png"][/img][/p]
